source: R6 (PLAN.md 11.6). v1 lists the cars that drive today and have a model: the game's own car_sedan (3.0 L), physics_sim's car_hyper and the 2.0 L sedan layouts car_sedan_rwd / car_sedan_awd. Not listed: car_sedan_787b (a rotary race car whose shuffle-mode driveline is a test vehicle, not a road car), the pipes/gen/sim/fuel/x3 variants (engine experiments that share the sedan model), tractor (no road use) - they can be added as plain entries. Paths are relative to the repository root. Chassis mass, box and spawn height are the interim copy of what physics_sim's vehicle files do not carry yet (physics request R5/R6): they equal what rg::Session and the Godot adapter used before the catalog existed.
